paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
notes: PandaX-II Run 9 (80 days, 2.7e4 kg-day) axioelectric-effect search. Three distinct 90% CL results encoded: (1) solar CBRD axion flat bound g_Ae < 4.35e-12 for 1e-5 to 1 keV/c^2 (1e-2 to 1e3 eV), rows 1-2; (2) galactic ALP DM flat bound g_Ae ~< 4e-13 for 1-25 keV/c^2 (1e3 to 2.5e4 eV), rows 3-4, which is the DM-halo search assuming rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (density applies ONLY to these points, not the solar bounds); (3) 57Fe 14.4 keV solar axion best point g_Ae = 6e-14 at 10 keV/c^2 (row 5), which assumes DFSZ g_AN. Note the paper text contains internal typos (4.35e-11 and 4.3e-14 in summary vs 4.35e-12 and ~4e-13 in abstract/results); abstract/results values used.
